Problem Statement
Write a program to determine whether a student is eligible to appear for an examination based on attendance percentage.
Description
A student must have at least 75% attendance to be eligible for the examination.
Read the following inputs:
Total number of classes conducted.
Number of classes attended.
Perform the following operations:
Calculate attendance percentage.
Calculate the number of classes missed.
Determine eligibility status.
Display all values in the specified format.
